In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover 2 major stories shaping the Indian economy and global markets:
1. India’s Hotel Giants Make Big Long-Term Bets
2. TRAI’s New Plan Could Transform Telecom Backhaul
TRAI is exploring wireless alternatives to fiber for connecting telecom towers. This move could lower costs and speed up 5G rollouts across India—especially in hard-to-reach areas—potentially reshaping how India’s telecom networks are built and expanded.
